home.subtitle: Start everyday office work, inspect current tasks, and manage the information your assistant can use.
home.startHint: Choose an example to place a complete instruction in the task box. Nothing runs until you send it.

reimbursement.title: Prepare a reimbursement package
reimbursement.prompt: Organize the attached invoices and receipts into a reimbursement checklist. Flag missing dates, amounts, categories, or approvals, and create a clear summary for me to review before submission.

requirements.title: Turn notes into requirements
requirements.prompt: Turn the attached notes into a requirements document with goals, users, scope, acceptance criteria, open questions, and risks. Mark every assumption and do not invent missing facts.

data.title: Analyze a data file
data.prompt: Analyze the attached spreadsheet. Check data quality first, then summarize key changes, unusual values, and conclusions supported by the data. Create a concise table of findings.

market.title: Prepare a market brief
market.prompt: Prepare a market brief for the topic I provide. Separate sourced facts from inference, compare the main alternatives, and list the evidence and dates behind each important conclusion.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: These are your real conversations and their current state.
tasks.manageHint: Open a task to inspect its messages and state. Stop an active run, add files, or amend requirements in the conversation so the existing execution and history controls are preserved.

status.preparationStarting: Démarrage de votre espace de travail
status.preparationTimedOut: La préparation prend trop de temps. Réessayez pour continuer.
status.preparationFailed: La préparation de l’environnement n’a pas abouti. Consultez la raison puis réessayez.
status.capabilityForbidden: Ce compte n’est pas autorisé à utiliser l’espace de travail. Demandez à votre administrateur de vérifier les rôles et autorisations.
status.environmentUnavailable: L’environnement d’exécution est indisponible. Réessayez ou demandez à votre administrateur de vérifier le service.
status.connectionRecovering: La connexion a été temporairement interrompue. Tentative de rétablissement…
status.bootstrapLoadFailed: La page n’a pas pu se charger. Rechargez-la pour réessayer.

status.resourceCheckDeferred: Capability updates could not be checked. Existing authorized capabilities remain available; a check will run later.

errors.noModel: Aucun modèle n’est disponible pour ce compte. Demandez à l’administrateur de votre organisation de vérifier le modèle par défaut et les autorisations d’accès.
errors.noCapability: No work capabilities are authorized for this account. Contact an administrator.
errors.prepareFailed: The work environment could not be prepared ({{code}}). Retry, or contact an administrator if it persists.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.subtitle: Upload source material, follow indexing results, search original passages, and inspect exact versions.
knowledge.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} and revoke it from future use?
knowledge.empty: Choose a knowledge base or add its first document

issues.fileType: This file type is not supported. Upload a PDF, Office file, image, Markdown, text, CSV, or JSON file.
issues.invalidDocument: This document could not be read. Re-export it from its source application, then upload the new copy.
issues.utf8: Save this text file as UTF-8, then upload it again.
issues.noText: No searchable text was found. Upload a text-based copy or an OCR-processed version.
issues.tooLarge: This document exceeds an indexing limit. Split or reduce the file, then upload the smaller parts.
issues.ocrUnavailable: OCR for this document is unavailable. Upload a text-based copy or ask an administrator to enable the required OCR language.
issues.contentChanged: The stored file changed before reindexing. Upload it as a new version to keep the version history accurate.
issues.temporary: Document extraction could not finish. Retry once; if it repeats, re-export the file or contact an administrator ({{code}}).
issues.failed: Indexing failed ({{code}}). Check the file and retry, or upload a corrected version.

knowledge.availableEmpty: No knowledge base is available. Create a private one, or ask an administrator to grant access.
